🔗 링크: https://huggingface.co/unsloth/GLM-5.3-Flash-GGUF

🔗 링크: https://huggingface.co/zai-org/GLM-5.3

🗂️ 소스: HF Model Trending | 유형: model_trending

🔗 링크: https://huggingface.co/tencent/Hy4-preview
